cards.name: Tangela
cards.description: It tangles any moving thing with its vines. Their subtle shaking is ticklish if you get ensnared.

cards.name: Ariados
cards.description: It spins thread from both its rear and its mouth. Then it wraps its prey up in thread and sips their bodily fluids at its leisure.

cards.name: Cofagrigus
cards.description: Grave robbers who mistake them for real coffins and get too close end up trapped inside their bodies.

cards.name: Litwick
cards.description: Litwick shines a light that absorbs the life energy of people and Pokémon, which becomes the fuel that it burns.

cards.name: Lampent
cards.description: It arrives near the moment of death and steals spirit from the body.

cards.name: Chandelure
cards.description: The spirits burned up in its ominous flame lose their way and wander this world forever.

cards.name: Meloetta
cards.description: Its melodies are sung with a special vocalization method that can control the feels of those who hear it.

cards.name: Mareanie
cards.description: It plunges the poison spike on its head into its prey. When the prey has weakened, Mareanie deals the finishing blow with its 10 tentacles.

cards.name: Nihilego
cards.description: One of the Ultra Beasts, it's unclear whether or not this Pokémon is sentient, but sometimes it can be observed behaving like a young girl.

cards.name: Poipole
cards.description: This Ultra Beast is well enough liked to be chosen as a first partner in its own world.

cards.name: Naganadel
cards.description: It stores hundreds of liters of poisonous liquid inside its body. It is one of the organisms known as UBs.

cards.name: Onix
cards.description: It usually lives underground. It searches for food while boring its way through the ground at 50 miles per hour.

cards.name: Hoppip
cards.description: It drifts on winds. It is said that when Hoppip gather in fields and mountains, spring is on the way.

cards.name: Sudowoodo
cards.description: Apparently, the larger the green parts of this Pokémon, the more collectors value it. It's a particular favorite among elderly people.

cards.name: Phanpy
cards.description: It is strong despite its compact size. It can easily pick up and carry an adult human on its back.

cards.name: Donphan
cards.description: The longer and bigger its tusks, the higher its rank in its herd. The tusks take long to grow.

cards.name: Hitmontop
cards.description: If you are enchanted by its smooth, dance-like kicks, you may get a closer experience with one than you'd like.

cards.name: Larvitar
cards.description: Born deep underground, it comes aboveground and becomes a pupa once it has finished eating the surrounding soil.

cards.name: Larvitar
cards.description: Born deep underground, it comes aboveground and becomes a pupa once it has finished eating the surrounding soil.

cards.name: Pupitar
cards.description: Its shell is as hard as sheet rock, and it is also very strong. Its thrashing can topple a mountain.

cards.name: Carbink
cards.description: Although this Pokémon is not especially rare, its glittering, jewel-draped body draws attention from people.

cards.name: Alolan Meowth
cards.description: When its delicate pride is wounded, or when the gold coin on its forehead is dirtied, it flies into a hysterical rage.

cards.name: Alolan Persian
cards.description: It looks down on everyone other than itself. Its preferred tactics are sucker punches and blindside attacks.

cards.name: Hoppip
cards.description: It drifts on winds. It is said that when Hoppip gather in fields and mountains, spring is on the way.

cards.name: Umbreon
cards.description: With its black fur, it blends into the darkness. It bides its time, and when prey appears, this Pokémon goes for its threat, and then eats it.

cards.name: Alolan Diglett
cards.description: Its golden hairs function as sensors. It pokes them out of its burrow to monitor its surroundings.

cards.name: Alolan Dugtrio
cards.description: These Pokémon are cherished in the Alola region, where they are thought to be feminine deities of the land incarnate.

cards.name: Forretress
cards.description: It remains immovably rooted to its tree. It scatters piece of its hard shell to drive its enemies away.

cards.name: Steelix
cards.description: It chews its way through boulders with its sturdy jaws. Its eyes can see in the darkness underground.

cards.name: Scizor
cards.description: Once it has identified an enemy, this Pokémon smashes it mercilessly with pincers hard as steel.

cards.name: Dialga
cards.description: It has the power to control time. It appears in Sinnoh-region myths as an ancient deity.

cards.name: Durant
cards.description: They attack in groups, covering themselves in steel armor to protect themselves from Heatmor.

cards.name: Cobalion
cards.description: It has a body and heart of steel. It worked with its allies to punish people when they hurt Pokémon.

cards.name: Skiploom
cards.description: It spreads its petals to absorb sunlight. It also floats in the air to get closer to the sun.

cards.name: Magearna
cards.description: Its mechanized body is merely a vessel. Its true self is its Soul-Heart, an artificial soul.

cards.name: Jigglypuff
cards.description: Jigglypuff posses a vocal range that exceeds 12 octaves, but each individual's singing skill depends on its own effort.

cards.name: Wigglytuff
cards.description: As it inhales, it expands…and expands…and expands. Wigglytuff compete to see which one can inflate itself the most.

cards.name: Marill
cards.description: The tip of its tail is filled with oil that is lighter than water, so it acts as a float.

cards.name: Azumarill
cards.description: The bubble-like pattern on its stomach helps it camouflage itself when it's in the water.

cards.name: Snubbull
cards.description: Its growls make its opponents uneasy. This laid-back Pokémon tends to sleep half the day.

cards.name: Granbull
cards.description: More timid than Snubbull, this Pokémon is doted on by young people amused at the contrast between its looks and its attitude.

cards.name: Ralts
cards.description: It is highly attuned to the emotions of people and Pokémon. It hides if it senses hostility.

cards.name: Jumpluff
cards.description: Even in the fiercest wind, it can control its fluff to make its way to any place in the world it wants.

cards.name: Kirlia
cards.description: It has a psychic power that enabled it to distort the space around it and see into the future.

cards.name: Gardevoir
cards.description: It has the power to predict the future. Its power peaks when it is protecting its Trainer.

cards.name: Dedenne
cards.description: It uses its tail to absorb electricity from power plants or from outlets in houses, and then it fires the electricity from its whiskers.

cards.name: Carbink
cards.description: Although this Pokémon is not especially rare, its glittering, jewel-draped body draws attention from people.

cards.name: Xerneas ◇
cards.description: When the horns on its head shine in seven colors, it is said to be sharing everlasting life.

cards.name: Cutiefly
cards.description: Myriads of Cutiefly flutter above the heads of people who have auras resembling those of flowers.

cards.name: Ribombee
cards.description: Some of Ribombee's pollen puffs are highly nutritious. They are sometimes sold as supplements.

cards.name: Morelull
cards.description: As it drowses the day away, it nourishes itself by sucking from tree roots. It wakens at the fall of night, wandering off in search of a new tree.

cards.name: Shiinotic
cards.description: It emits flickering spores that cause drowsiness. When its prey succumb to sleep, this Pokémon feeds on them by sucking in their energy.

cards.name: Pineco
cards.description: It looks just like a pinecone. Its shell protects it from bird Pokémon that peck it by mistake.

cards.name: Tapu Lele
cards.description: As it flutters about, it scatters its strangely glowing scales. Touching them is said to restore good health on the spot.

cards.name: Tapu Fini
cards.description: The guardian deity of Poni, it can control water. People say it can create pure water that will wash away any uncleanness.

cards.name: Chansey
cards.description: Not only are these Pokémon fast runners, they're also few in number, so anyone who finds one must be lucky indeed.

cards.name: Blissey
cards.description: Its fluffy fur coat acts as a sensor, enabling it to read the feelings of people and Pokémon.

cards.name: Ditto ◇
cards.description: With its astonishing capacity for metamorphosis, it can get along with anything. It does not get along well with its fellow Ditto.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.description: Current studies show it can evolve into an incredible eight different species of Pokémon.

cards.name: Stantler
cards.description: The curved antlers change the flow of air to create a strange space where reality is distorted.

cards.name: Smeargle
cards.description: It draws symbols all over the place to mark its territory. In towns with many Smeargle, the walls are covered in graffiti.

cards.name: Miltank
cards.description: Most people raise it for its milk, but it's quite tough and strong, so it's also well suited for battle.

cards.name: Shuckle
cards.description: It stores berries inside its shell. To avoid attacks, it hides beneath rocks and remains completely still.

cards.name: Ho-Oh
cards.description: It will reveal itself before a pure-hearted Trainer by shining its bright, rainbow-colored wings.

cards.name: Kecleon
cards.description: It changes its shading to match its surroundings so it can sneak up on prey. Only its belly patterns stay fixed.

cards.name: Kecleon
cards.description: It changes its shading to match its surroundings so it can sneak up on prey. Only its belly patterns stay fixed.

cards.name: Pikipek
cards.description: This Pokémon feeds on berries, whose leftover seeds become the ammunition for attacks it fires off from its mouth.

cards.name: Pikipek
cards.description: This Pokémon feeds on berries, whose leftover seeds become the ammunition for attacks it fires off from its mouth.

cards.name: Trumbeak
cards.description: By bending its beak, it can produce a variety of calls and brand itself a noisy nuisance for its neighbors.

cards.name: Toucannon
cards.description: Within its beak, its internal gas ignites, explosively launching seeds with enough power to pulverize boulders.

cards.name: Heracross
cards.description: With its Herculean powers, it can easily throw around an object that is 100 times its own weight.

cards.name: Celebi ◇
cards.description: It has the power to travel across time, but it is said to appear only in peaceful times.

cards.name: Tangrowth
cards.description: Its vines grow so profusely that, in the warm season, you can't even see its eyes.

cards.name: Treecko
cards.description: Small hooks on the bottom of its feet catch on walls and ceilings. That is how it can hang from above.

cards.name: Grovyle
cards.description: It lives in dense jungles. While closing in on its prey, it leaps from branch to branch.

cards.name: Wurmple
cards.description: It lives among the tall grass and in forests. It repels attacks by raising up the spikes on its rear.

cards.name: Wurmple
cards.description: It lives among the tall grass and in forests. It repels attacks by raising up the spikes on its rear.

cards.name: Silcoon
cards.description: It drinks dew that collects on its silk and waits for evolution. Its hard cocoon repels attacks.

cards.name: Beautifly
cards.description: It has an aggressive nature. It stabs prey with its long, narrow mouth to drain the prey's fluids.

cards.name: Cascoon
cards.description: It never forgets any attack it endured while in the cocoon. After evolution, it seeks payback.

cards.name: Dustox
cards.description: It violently flutters its wings to scatter toxic dust when attacked. It becomes active after sunset.

cards.name: Nincada
cards.description: It can sometimes live underground for more than 10 years. It absorbs nutrients from the roots of trees.

cards.name: Scyther
cards.description: While young, they live together deep in the mountains, training themselves in how to fight with their scythes and move at high speeds.

cards.name: Ninjask
cards.description: Because it moves so quickly, it sometimes becomes unseeable. It congregates around tree sap.

cards.name: Combee
cards.description: It collects and delivers honey to its colony. At night, they cluster to form a beehive and sleep.

cards.name: Vespiquen
cards.description: Its abdomen is a honeycomb for grubs. It raises its grubs on honey collected by Combee.

cards.name: Shaymin
cards.description: The blooming of Gracidea flowers confers the power of flight upon it. Feelings of gratitude are the message it delivers.

cards.name: Skiddo
cards.description: If it has sunshine and water, it doesn't need to eat, because it can generate energy from the leaves on its back.

cards.name: Gogoat
cards.description: They inhabit mountainous regions. The leader of the herd is decided by a battle of clashing horns.

cards.name: Tapu Bulu
cards.description: The guardian deity of Ula'ula is a lazy Pokémon. It commands plants to immobilize its foes and then deals them a savage blow with its horns.

cards.name: Moltres
cards.description: One of the legendary bird Pokémon. It is said that its appearance indicates the coming of spring.

cards.name: Cyndaquil
cards.description: It has a timid nature. If it is startled, the flames on its back burn more vigorously.

cards.name: Pinsir
cards.description: One solid blow from its horns is enough to split apart a large tree. Its greatest rival in Alola is Vikavolt.

cards.name: Cyndaquil
cards.description: It has a timid nature. If it is startled, the flames on its back burn more vigorously.

cards.name: Quilava
cards.description: Be careful if it turns its back during battle. It means that it will attack with the fire on its back.

cards.name: Typhlosion
cards.description: It has a secret, devastating move. It rubs its blazing fur together to cause huge explosions.

cards.name: Slugma
cards.description: Its body is made of magma. If it doesn't keep moving, its body will cool and harden.

cards.name: Houndour
cards.description: To corner prey, they check each other's location using barks that only they can understand.

cards.name: Houndoom
cards.description: The flames it breathes when angry contain toxins. If they cause a burn, it will hurt forever.

cards.name: Entei
cards.description: It is said that when it roars, a volcano erupts somewhere around the globe.

cards.name: Heatran
cards.description: Boiling blood, like magma, circulates through its body. It makes its dwelling place in volcanic caves.

cards.name: Victini
cards.description: When it shares the infinite energy it creates, that being's entire body will be overflowing with power.

cards.name: Chikorita
cards.description: It uses the leaf on its head to determine the temperature and humidity. It loves to sunbathe.

cards.name: Litleo
cards.description: They set off on their own from their pride and live by themselves to become stronger. These hot-blooded Pokémon are quick to fight.

cards.name: Pyroar
cards.description: With fiery breath of more than 10,000 degrees Fahrenheit, they viciously threaten any challenger. The females protect the pride's cubs.

cards.name: Alolan Vulpix
cards.description: In hot weather, this Pokémon makes ice shards with its six tails and sprays them around to cool itself off.

cards.name: Slowpoke
cards.description: Alolan home cooking involves drying Slowpoke tails and then simmering them into a salty stew.

cards.name: Slowking
cards.description: This Pokémon is so famed for its intellect that a proverb still persists in some regions: "When in doubt, ask Slowking."

cards.name: Lapras
cards.description: These Pokémon were once near extinction due to poaching. Following protective regulations, there is now an overabundance of them.

cards.name: Delibird
cards.description: It has a generous habit of sharing its food with people and Pokémon, so it's always scrounging around for more food.

cards.name: Mantine
cards.description: While elegantly swimming in the sea, it ignores Remoraid that cling to its fins seeking food scraps.

cards.name: Suicune
cards.description: Said to be the embodiment of north winds, it can instantly purify filthy, murky water.

cards.name: Chikorita
cards.description: It uses the leaf on its head to determine the temperature and humidity. It loves to sunbathe.

cards.name: Cubchoo
cards.description: Their snot is a barometer of health. When healthy, their snot is sticky and the power of their ice moves increases.

cards.name: Beartic
cards.description: It freezes its breath to create fangs and claws of ice to fight with. Cold northern areas are its habitat.

cards.name: White Kyurem
cards.description: It generates a powerful, freezing energy inside itself, but its body became frozen when the energy leaked out.

cards.name: Popplio
cards.description: This Pokémon snorts body fluids from its nose, blowing balloons to smash into its foes. It's famous for being a hard worker.

cards.name: Popplio
cards.description: This Pokémon can control water bubbles. It practice diligently so it can learn to make big bubbles.

cards.name: Brionne
cards.description: It cares deeply for its companions. When its Trainer is feeling down, it performs a cheery dance to try and help.

cards.name: Primarina
cards.description: Its singing voice is its chief weapon in battle. This Pokémon's Trainer must prioritize the daily maintenance of its throat at all costs.

cards.name: Mareanie
cards.description: It's found crawling on beaches and seafloors. The coral that grows on Corsola's head is as good as a five-star banquet to this Pokémon.

cards.name: Toxapex
cards.description: Those attacked by Toxapex's poison will suffer intense pain for three days and three nights. Post-recovery, there will be some aftereffects.

cards.name: Bayleef
cards.description: The buds that ring its neck give off a spicy aroma that perks people up.

cards.name: Bruxish
cards.description: It stuns its prey with psychokinesis and then grinds them to mush with its strong teeth. Even Shellder's shell is no match for it.

cards.name: Electabuzz
cards.description: Electricity leaks from it in amounts far greater than the amount of electricity it eats.

cards.name: Electivire
cards.description: When it gets excited, it thumps its chest. With every thud, thunder roars and electric sparks shower all around.

cards.name: Chinchou
cards.description: It lives in the depths beyond the reach of sunlight. It flashes lights on its antennae to communicate with others of its kind.

cards.name: Lanturn
cards.description: This Pokémon flashes a bright light that blinds its prey. This creates an opening for it to deliver an electrical attack.

cards.name: Mareep
cards.description: It stores lots of air in its soft fur, allowing it to stay cool in summer and warm in winter.

cards.name: Mareep
cards.description: It stores lots of air in its soft fur, allowing it to stay cool in summer and warm in winter.

cards.name: Flaaffy
cards.description: If its coat becomes fully charged with electricity, its tail lights up. It fires hair that zaps on impact.

cards.name: Ampharos
cards.description: The tail's tip shines brightly and can be seen from far away. It acts as a beacon for lost people.

cards.name: Raikou
cards.description: This rough Pokémon stores energy inside its body, then sweeps across the land, shooting off electricity.

cards.name: Meganium
cards.description: Meganium's breath has the power to revive dead grass and plants. It can make them healthy again.

cards.name: Pachirisu
cards.description: A pair may be seen rubbing their cheek pouches together in an effort to share stored electricity.

cards.name: Blitzle
cards.description: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use the frequency and rhythm of these flashes to communicate.

cards.name: Zebstrika
cards.description: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.

cards.name: Stunfisk
cards.description: It conceals itself in the mud of the seashore. Then it waits. When prey touch it, it delivers a jolt of electricity.

cards.name: Dedenne
cards.description: It uses its tail to absorb electricity from power plants or from outlets in houses, and then it fires the electricity from its whiskers.

cards.name: Tapu Koko
cards.description: It confuses its enemies by flying too quickly for the eye to follow. It has a hair-trigger temper but forgets what made it angry an instant later.

cards.name: Natu
cards.description: It usually forages for food on the ground but may, on rare occasions, hop onto branches to peck at shoots.

cards.name: Xatu
cards.description: They say that it stays still and quiet because it is seeing both the past and future at the same time.

cards.name: Espeon
cards.description: It unleashes psychic power from the orb on its forehead. When its power is exhausted, the orb grows dull and dark.

cards.name: Spinarak
cards.description: Some fishermen weave its sturdy thread into nets to catch fish Pokémon.

cards.name: Unown
cards.description: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or Unown came first.

cards.name: Unown
cards.description: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or Unown came first.

cards.name: Unown
cards.description: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or Unown came first.

cards.name: Wobbuffet
cards.description: To keep its pitch-black tail hidden, it live quietly in the darkness. It is never first to attack.

cards.name: Girafarig
cards.description: Its tail has a small brain of its own. Beware! If you get close, it may react to your scent by biting.

cards.name: Shedinja
cards.description: A most peculiar Pokémon that somehow appears in a Poké Ball when a Nincada evolves.

cards.name: Sableye
cards.description: This Pokémon is feared. When its gemstone eyes begin to glow with a sinister shine, it's believed that Sableye will steal people's spirits away.

cards.name: Giratina
cards.description: It was banished for its violence. It silently gazed upon the old world from the Distortion World.

cards.name: Yamask
cards.description: Each of them carries a mask that used to be its face when it was human. Sometimes they look at it and cry.
